detail.goal: Sign on as operator "teller1" with [REDACTED] "[REDACTED]" at branch "MAIN-001", then from the Main Menu choose Funds Transfer, search for member number "100987" (leave "Search by" set to Member Number), select that member from the results, then on the member record page click "Funds Transfer" in the ACTIONS row. On the transfer form: set From Share to "100987-S0001-13", set To Share to "100987-MMKT-11", enter Amount "5.00", enter Memo "Adaptation Project demo transfer", and click Continue. On the confirmation ("CONFIRM FUNDS TRANSFER") page, click Post Transfer. Once you reach "TRANSFER POSTED", extract the Confirmation number (store as "confirmationNumber").
